xsd_support.description: Provides a more powerful and extensible schema language than DTDs, supporting data typing, namespaces, complex element/attribute constraints, and inheritance.
xsd_support.xsd_example: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"> <xs:element name="person"> <xs:complexType> <xs:sequence> <xs:element name="name" type="xs:string"/> <xs:element name="age" type="xs:integer"/> </xs:sequence> </xs:complexType> </xs:element> </xs:schema>

xmldsig_support.description: Enables digital signatures for XML documents, ensuring authenticity, integrity, and non-repudiation of XML content or parts thereof.

features.feature: Digital signatures for authenticity and integrity
Support for signing entire documents or specific parts
Standardized by W3C as XML Signature (XMLDSig)
